zh-Hans.description:
MeshDrop 是一款免费开源的附近设备分享工具，让 Windows、Mac、iPhone 和 iPad 通过同一局域网直接传送文字、链接、图片、视频和文件。无需注册账号，传输不经过云端中转。

适用范围
• Windows 10 1809 或更新版本，以及 Windows 11。
• 与 Mac、iPhone、iPad 互传时，Apple 端需安装 MeshDrop 1.1 或更新版本。
• 双方设备需连接同一 Wi-Fi 或局域网，并保持 MeshDrop 打开；网络必须允许设备之间互相访问。
• Windows 版暂不支持蓝牙传输或 Apple 点对点 Wi-Fi。仓库中其他平台的开发进度请参阅 GitHub。

主要功能
• 自动发现局域网设备，发送与接收文字、链接和文件。
• 文件选择与拖放发送，查看传输进度和本机会话历史。
• TLS 1.3 加密与设备身份双向认证；首次连接核对设备指纹，可记住信任关系。
• 系统托盘、传输通知，以及简体中文和英文界面。

下载 Apple 版（iPhone / iPad / Mac）
https://apps.apple.com/app/meshdrop/id6772689903

GitHub 开源仓库与问题反馈（MIT 许可证）
https://github.com/chenqi92/share

官网与使用介绍
https://kkape.com/tools/share

实际传输速度取决于网络和设备性能。旧版明文协议客户端无法连接此版本。
features: Windows 10 / 11 与 Mac、iPhone、iPad 在同一局域网互传
TLS 1.3 加密、双向设备认证与首次配对确认
发送文字、链接与文件，支持拖放和传输进度
本机会话历史、信任设备管理与系统托盘
免费开源（MIT），提供 Apple App Store 和 GitHub 入口

en-US.description:
MeshDrop is a free, open-source tool for sharing text, links, images, videos and files directly between Windows, Mac, iPhone and iPad over your local network. No account or cloud relay is required.

Compatibility
• Windows 10 version 1809 or later, and Windows 11.
• Mac, iPhone and iPad need MeshDrop 1.1 or later for native encrypted transfers.
• Keep MeshDrop open on both devices and connect them to the same Wi-Fi or LAN. The network must allow devices to reach each other.
• The Windows app does not currently support Bluetooth transfer or Apple peer-to-peer Wi-Fi. See GitHub for the development status of other platforms.

Features
• Discover nearby devices on your LAN and send or receive text, links and files.
• Choose or drag files to send, follow transfer progress and view local conversation history.
• TLS 1.3 encryption and mutual device authentication. Compare fingerprints on first pairing and remember devices you trust.
• System tray, transfer notifications, and Simplified Chinese and English interfaces.

Get the Apple app (iPhone / iPad / Mac)
https://apps.apple.com/app/meshdrop/id6772689903

Source code and issue tracker (MIT license)
https://github.com/chenqi92/share

Website and guide
https://kkape.com/tools/share

Transfer speed depends on your network and devices. Older plaintext-protocol clients cannot connect to this version.

certificationNotes:
MeshDrop is a free, open-source WinUI 3 desktop app for direct local-network text and file sharing. No account, subscription, paid feature, or test credentials are required.

Testing: Install MeshDrop on two Windows PCs, or on a Windows PC and an Apple device running MeshDrop 1.1 or later. Keep both apps open on the same LAN/Wi-Fi with device-to-device communication allowed. Choose a discovered device, send text or a small file, and approve the first pairing/receive prompt on the recipient. Compare device fingerprints when pairing. Verify both transfer directions and local history. Native transfers require TLS 1.3; older plaintext clients cannot connect. Windows supports version 1809 and later of Windows 10, and Windows 11. Windows does not support Bluetooth transfer or Apple peer-to-peer Wi-Fi.

Apple app: https://apps.apple.com/app/meshdrop/id6772689903
Source and issue tracker: https://github.com/chenqi92/share
Privacy policy: https://kkape.com/privacy/share/

The runFullTrust capability is needed by this packaged WinUI desktop application for its desktop process, local TCP/mDNS communication, file selection and transfer, and system tray integration. Startup at sign-in is optional and off by default. Settings > About includes platform scope, Apple download, GitHub, website and privacy links.
